photos.title: Condo tower in Myrtle Beach, South Carolina
photos.what: A condo tower of about 15 stories in Myrtle Beach at dusk: blue, gray and yellow walls, lit balconies on the left side, two antennas on top, palm tops at the bottom edge and the corner of a pink building at the right. No person, sign or plate is in the cropped frame.
photos.caption: A condo tower in Myrtle Beach. Inside the city, only about 1 in 11 condo units is taxed at the 4 percent rate as the home its owner lives in.
photos.alt: A tall blue, gray and yellow condo tower in Myrtle Beach at dusk, with palm trees in front
photos.author: Carl Dunn
photos.credit: Photo: Carl Dunn, CC BY 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons
photos.provenance: Flickr upload by Carl Dunn (https://www.flickr.com/photos/22991988@N04/3587435159/), moved to Commons by File Upload Bot (Magnus Manske); flickrreview passed on January 28, 2010. photos.subject_check: Looked at full size by the researcher (PLAN.md) and the verifier (VERIFY.md, Photo candidate: Licence OK) at 1280 x 1912, and by this page's writer on 2026-11-04 at 1280 x 1912 and as the 1280 x 1200 crop: a condo tower at dusk with palms; the two people walking at the bottom of the original are outside the crop, and no sign or plate is in it. The county parcel layer has 138 units of this building in the City of Myrtle Beach tax districts (898, 899), 134 at 6 percent (VERIFY.md). The caption names no building and uses ledger row 22's corrected wording. The photo partner's shot (shot-list.md, item 3) replaces it.
